raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  # On version bumps, also update the submodule commits below and their sha256s.
  # The build fails via check_submodules.sh if they don't match the upstream tag.
  version: "2.3.1"
  imgui_commit: 3912b3d9a9c1b3f17431aebafd86d2f40ee6e59c
  implot_commit: 4707b245fbcd69075b1a8a74fa8d2435561b3134

package:
  name: dearpygui
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/hoffstadt/DearPyGui/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: d86822978f7856ea8556a715bb84d0ed4f909720c9ec78f6e1ec20102ad73ee2
    patches:
      - patches/0001-Build-with-conda-forge-toolchain-and-system-glfw-fre.patch
      - patches/0002-Find-Python-with-Interpreter-and-Development.Module-.patch
      - patches/0003-Remove-unused-atlbase.h-include.patch
  # git submodules pinned by DearPyGui (imgui docking branch with DearPyGui-specific config)
  - url: https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/archive/${{ imgui_commit }}.tar.gz
    sha256: cd1cd7d279e568217e9caef0d49b2f199edc65cf0b9497712bc422cef5339bc0
    target_directory: thirdparty/imgui
  - url: https://github.com/epezent/implot/archive/${{ implot_commit }}.tar.gz
    sha256: f5228da176a03d9b179e2f58438b7f69d9e8555d2008243095dfab2a80c5e886
    target_directory: thirdparty/implot

build:
  number: 1
  script:
    # Sources are identical across platforms, so checking on unix is sufficient.
    - if: unix
      then:
        - bash ${RECIPE_DIR}/check_submodules.sh ${{ version }} ${{ imgui_commit }} ${{ implot_commit }}
    - if: win
      then:
        - echo ${{ version }}> version_number.txt
      else:
        - echo ${{ version }} > version_number.txt
    - if: osx
      then:
        # CMake only adds $PREFIX/include via CFLAGS/CXXFLAGS, which aren't used for .m/.mm files
        - export OBJCFLAGS="${CFLAGS}" OBJCXXFLAGS="${CXXFLAGS}"
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - cmake
    - ninja
    - if: unix
      then:
        - git
    - if: build_platform != host_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ host_platform }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools
    - glfw
    - if: linux
      then:
        - libgl-devel
        - xorg-libx11
    - if: win
      then:
        - freetype
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - dearpygui
        - dearpygui.dearpygui
      pip_check: true
  - script:
      - python -c "import dearpygui.dearpygui as dpg; dpg.create_context(); dpg.destroy_context()"
      - python -c "import dearpygui; assert dearpygui.__version__ == '${{ version }}', dearpygui.__version__"

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/hoffstadt/DearPyGui
  summary: 'DearPyGui: A simple Python GUI Toolkit'
  description: |
    Dear PyGui is an easy-to-use, dynamic, GPU-Accelerated, cross-platform
    graphical user interface toolkit (GUI) for Python. It is built on top of
    Dear ImGui.
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - thirdparty/imgui/LICENSE.txt
    - thirdparty/implot/LICENSE
    - thirdparty/imnodes/LICENSE.md
    - thirdparty/ImGuiFileDialog/LICENSE
  documentation: https://dearpygui.readthedocs.io/
  repository: https://github.com/hoffstadt/DearPyGui

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - pavelzw
